cta_text.description: Fix cycle 3 item 4: the ONE CTA button text for this page. The renderer reuses it verbatim in the hero, the sticky bar, and the final CTA block -- choose it once here, never repeat/vary it elsewhere.

cta_url.description: The CTA's destination URL, reused everywhere cta_text is.

problem.description: H2 + 2-3 paragraphs on the reader's problem as the ad frames it; objections from the ad become the problem statements.

attributed_to_customer.description: True only if this paragraph states a number that comes solely from the ad speaker's own estimate/hedge (ad_brief.speaker_experience), phrased as her own words, never as a brand fact and never carrying a claim_id.

how_it_works.description: H2 + 3 steps or feature blocks, each with an image slot. Technical facts from facts_pack.specs only. Fix cycle 3 item 3: at least 3 steps combined must carry a product-benefit claim_id -- what the sauna does or is built with (e.g. medical-grade red light therapy, full-spectrum near/mid/far infrared, US-owned company, free shipping, limited lifetime warranty) -- not price, shipping-policy, warranty-terms, or returns-policy; the gate fails the page otherwise.

specs_and_proof.description: table (6-10 rows) + 2-3 verified claims with citations.

social_proof.description: review summary from verified_claims; up to 3 quotes only if they exist verbatim in facts_pack.reviews_summary. Never invent quotes.

faq.description: 5-7 questions from ad objections and common buyer questions; answers from facts_pack.

items.description: text is the answer (named 'text', not 'answer', so the claims gate's trigger-word check applies to it).

final_cta.description: Headline + financing/warranty lines. CTA text/url are the shared page.cta_text/page.cta_url from the hero -- do not repeat them here.

images.description: 4-6 images total from the asset library, referenced by asset id (this list is a convenience index of everything used).
